content:
AltiSales is a data-driven Go-To-Market (GTM) consulting and SDR outsourcing company. It is an expert in building, useful and scaling outbound B2B sales systems. Tito founded the agency.

In fact, the company emphasises heavily on mathematical outbound frameworks, account-based targeting and message-market fit. AltiSales mainly works with B2B SaaS companies, enterprise technology vendors and growth-stage organisations. Especially those looking to build predictable outbound revenue engines.

How does AltiSales work?

AltiSales operates through a structured outbound framework, better known as “SDR Assembly Line”. Some important phases in their work include:

  1. Collaborative Prospecting and Account Scoring- AltiSales makes mathematical scoring models. They also understand high-intent buyer signals and Ideal Customer Profiles. 
  2. Playbook Design and Outreach Setup- It makes custom outbound email sequences and call scripts. 
  3. Multi-channel Outbound Execution - The company's SDRs are setting up custom outreach campaigns. It is done across multiple platforms, including email, phone, and LinkedIn. 
  4. Lead qualification and Meeting Scheduling- AltiSales’ SDRs qualify leads and manage early-stage objections. Later, they are directly scheduled onto internal calendars.
  5. IP Transfer and In-House Migration- It can eventually transition operations internally. 

Core Capabilities

GTM Strategy and Execution

AltiSales makes enterprise-grade outbound sales frameworks. It usually focuses on message-market fit and predictable pipeline generation. 

Mathematical Account Scoring

It develops custom scoring algorithms to focus on high-converting accounts and reduce wasted outreach.

SDR Outsourcing and Team Augmentation

The agency has dedicated SDRs and Data Research Reps who work together to manage prospecting, qualification, and outreach execution. 

RevOps and Sales Technology Optimisation-

AlthiSales configures outreach systems. It uses Outreach.io, Salesforce, HubSpot, and advanced sales-automation workflows. 

Proprietary Analytics Infrastructure

It has an internal analytics system. In turn, the system monitors pipeline health, sentiment patterns, and conversion bottlenecks in real time. 

What makes Altistar stand out?

AlthiSales stands out by focusing on engineered outbound systems. It includes:

  1. The SDR Assembly Line Model- AltiSales separates research operations from outbound sales execution. It allows SDRs to focus only on live buyer conversations. 
  2. Rent-To-Own GTM Infrastructure- It transfers workflows and playbooks directly back to clients. 
  3. Quantitative Target Market Scoring- The company makes custom mathematical targeting systems.
  4. Enterprise-Level GTM Expertise- AltiSales supports outbound growth initiatives for companies like IBM, LaunchDarkly, Bombora and more. 
  5. Advanced RevOps Auditing- Its proprietary analytics systems find conversion bottlenecks, messaging inefficiencies and outreach performance issues.

Key Services

  • Fully Managed SDR Outsourcing: AltiSales employs complete outbound sales teams. It involves both SDRs and Data Research Reps. 
  • GTM Strategy Consulting- It redesigns and optimises outbound sales systems. It is meant for startups, scale-ups, and enterprise organisations. 
  • Fractional Sales Leadership- The agency allows listeners to access interim sales leadership and outbound pipeline management expertise. 
  • RevOps and CRM Optimisation- AltiSales configures and optimises sales technology stacks, CRM systems, and outreach automation workflows. 
  • SDR Recruitment and Hiring-It assists businesses in finding and optimising long-term internal SDR talent.

Advanced Capabilities

  1. Proprietary Caddy Analytics Engine- AltiSales uses its Caddy software platform. It helps to audit sales sequences, track conversion bottlenecks and check SDR performance. 
  2. Algorithmic Target Market Addressing- It scores accounts dynamically based on job changes, organisational restructuring, technology adoption and buyer intent signals. 
  3. Strategic Unity Messaging Framework: The company uses its proprietary outreach Framework. It has multi-stage psychological sequencing to improve buyer engagement. 
  4. Advanced Sequence Architecture- AltiSales’ campaigns follow structured multi-touch sequences. It involves problem amplification, ROI positioning for education, and social proof. 
  5. GTM Ecosystem and Venture Support- AltiSales supports SaaS startups and Strategic GTM acceleration and growth infrastructure.

Who should work with AltiSales?

  • Enterprise SaaS and technology companies, including cybersecurity platforms and cloud Infrastructure providers 
  • Venture-Backed Startups, such as seed-stage and series A SaaS businesses. 
  • IT and Managed Service Providers, like Cloud migration firms and enterprise architecture consultants 
  • Enterprise RevOps teams, including companies with users performing SDR and businesses needing outbound restructuring

Best-Fit Industries

  • Enterprise SaaS and Technology 
  • Information Technology and MSPs
  • Data Intelligence 
  • HR Tech and EdTech 
  • Cybersecurity

Key Use Cases

  • Launching a new GTM Motion- AltiSales enables companies to make outbound playbooks for new enterprise products 
  • Revamping Underperforming SDR Teams- It restructures inefficient outbound operations. 
  • Transitioning Sales Operations In-House- The agency helps companies as a temporary accelerator before migrating systems internally.
  • Deep Enterprise Account Penetration- AltiSales supports account-based marketing campaigns. 
  • Optimising Outreach Infrastructure- Companies use AltiSales to improve CRM architecture, outbound automation and sequence performance.

Pros

  • Highly specialised SDR and research teams 
  • Advanced mathematical account scoring systems 
  • Strong RevOps and sales tech expertise 
  • Rent-To-Own operation model

Considerations 

  • Premium pricing 
  • Needs higher Annual Contact Value products 
  • Ideal for B2B Tech and enterprise sales environments

Top Alternatives to Consider

  • MarketJoy- Specializes in multi-channel B2B lead generation services
  • Belkins- Impressive multi-channel outreach 
  • Martal Group- Ideal for SaaS and enterprise software companies 
  • MemoryBlue- Best for companies that focus on SDR recruitment 
  • CIENCE- Exceptional AI-powered prospecting syste

Final Words

AlthiSales is among the most strategically engineered GTM Consulting and SDR outsourcing providers. It is ideal for enterprise B2B companies and high-growth SaaS organisations. They use mathematical account scoring, specialised SDR operations and advanced RevOps systems to score outbound sales Infrastructure. 

Do you want to make a scalable outbound GTM engine with a high-intent SDR appointment engine? AlthiSales enables businesses to engineer predictable pipeline growth with strategic GTM consulting and outsourced sales development.
